narrative: Material PL1__M2E56FF7 shows stable, high-volume demand (CV=0.14) with no detectable trend across 93 working days. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.48), dominated by transport uncertainty. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is recommended with safety stock of 61,594 units to achieve the 95% service level. The SAP safety lead time should be reduced from 5.0 to 1.97 days, as the data shows suppliers delivering significantly faster than the current ERP assumption.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and stable (CV=0.14) with 100% non-zero days, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy ideal. EOQ at 513,311 units is well above the MOQ of 41,119 and fits within storage capacity, so no quantity compression is needed. The normal approximation for demand during lead time is appropriate given the stable CV.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity constraint is satisfied: safety_stock (61,594) + order_quantity (513,311) = 574,905 units, which is below max_storage_units (603,487). No capacity cap binds.
